name: The Monogamy Law
tagline: The bodies are public and the pairings are absolute. Sex-positive was never the same thing as shared.
body:
THE ENTIRE FOUND FAMILY IS MONOGAMOUS. Every couple in every house. RULED BY VIRAENA ON 9 SEPTEMBER AND FILED AS A GOVERNING LAW BECAUSE IT PREVENTS A WHOLE CLASS OF ERROR THAT NOTHING ELSE IN THIS ARCHIVE GUARDS AGAINST.

AND THE DISTINCTION IT PROTECTS IS THE ONE THE ARCHIVE COLLAPSED: SEX-POSITIVE IS NOT NON-MONOGAMOUS. This compound is loud, explicit, unashamed and permanently horny. Nobody gets up to close a door. Bella announces the household’s business across a lawn. There is a chalkboard in the kitchen four feet wide with a tally on it. Panties tent, nipples go hard, cocks leak, and every woman here knows what every other woman sounds like. NONE OF THAT IS SHARING. THE BODIES ARE PUBLIC AND THE PAIRINGS ARE ABSOLUTE.

WHY IT HOLDS, IN HER WORDS: IF IT WEREN’T, ALL HELL WOULD BREAK LOOSE. And she named four specific breakages, which are four pieces of characterisation arriving through a counterfactual rather than an event.
MERCEDES SINCLAIR WOULD BE PROPOSITIONING AND SAMPLING EVERYONE AGAIN. The word is AGAIN. See q-mercedes-again.
ROXANNE VALEHEART AND QUINN LUTINIA WOULD BE SAMPLING EVERY BRAT. Both of them, and the target class is specified: BRATS.
WYNTER MORRISON WOULD BE TRYING THE OUTPUT OF EVERYONE AND COMPARING IT TO KATHERINE’S. Which is the most revealing of the four, because the comparison is the point — the appetite is a MEASURING INSTRUMENT and the baseline is her own wife.
RAE STEWART WOULD BE WITH EVERY TOP. Not every woman. EVERY TOP.

THESE ARE DISPOSITIONS, NOT HISTORY, AND THE ARCHIVE IS FILING THEM AS DISPOSITIONS. Nothing here says any of it happened. What it says is that FOUR WOMEN ARE HELD BY THE SAME LAW IN FOUR DIFFERENT DIRECTIONS, and that the law is not decoration for any of them.

WHAT THE LAW DOES NOT MEAN. It does not mean modesty, privacy, shame, closed doors, quiet, or restraint in speech. It does not mean a woman cannot look, admire, comment, compare, flirt across a kitchen, or lose an argument about whose ass is better. IT MEANS NOBODY CROSSES A PAIRING. And it is not enforced by anybody — there is no rule on the house-rules list about it, no penalty, and no authority. IT SIMPLY IS HOW THIS FAMILY WORKS.

SELENE AND VIRAENA ARE NOT AN EXCEPTION, WHICH IS THE CORRECTION. The Archive filed their exclusivity as DISTINCTIVE — as ONE MARRIAGE THAT DOES NOT PARTICIPATE IN THE THING THE HOUSE IS OTHERWISE FAMOUS FOR. THERE IS NO SUCH THING TO PARTICIPATE IN. They are the oldest monogamous couple on a compound of monogamous couples. See c-monogamy.

JARL YRSA REMAINS THE ONLY RECORDED COUNTER-STRUCTURE IN THE CANON, AND SHE IS A THOUSAND YEARS AND ONE WORLD-EVENT AWAY. A HUNDRED AND FORTY-SOMETHING WIVES IN ONE MARRIAGE BED. That was a marriage too, and it was not this one, and nothing about it is a precedent for Ghost Haven.
